title: 跨分片聚合：局部 top-k 归并全局 top-k（正反用例）
expected_output:
=== 跨分片聚合：局部 top-k 归并全局 top-k ===
总记录 = 1000, 分片数 = 4, k = 10
全局 top-10 (id,score) =
  id=1     score=1499
  id=501   score=1499
  id=5     score=1495
  id=505   score=1495
  id=9     score=1491
  id=509   score=1491
  id=13    score=1487
  id=513   score=1487
  id=17    score=1483
  id=517   score=1483

每分片记录数 = [250, 250, 250, 250]
每分片 top-3 score = [[900, 900, 896], [1499, 1499, 1495], [898, 898, 894], [897, 897, 893]]

[正确] 每分片各取 top-10 再归并取 top-10 -> 与全局一致 : True
[错误] 把 k 平均摊到分片，每分片只取 top-2 再归并 -> 一致 : False
[错误] 只在 shard0 内取 top-10 -> 一致 : False

归并正确性的充要条件：每分片返回的候选数 k_local >= 全局 k。
判据 k_local=10 时正确 : True ; k_local=2 时正确 : False
判据 正确结果的首位就是全局最高分 : True
code:
N = 1000
SHARDS = 4
K = 10

recs = []
for i in range(N):
    if i % SHARDS == 1:
        score = 1000 + (500 - i % 500)
    else:
        score = 900 - (i % 900)
    recs.append((i, score))


def key(r):
    return (-r[1], r[0])


shards = {}
for r in recs:
    shards.setdefault(r[0] % SHARDS, []).append(r)

GLOBAL = sorted(recs, key=key)[:K]


def take_local(k):
    out = []
    for s in sorted(shards):
        out.extend(sorted(shards[s], key=key)[:k])
    return sorted(out, key=key)[:K]


correct = take_local(K)
wrong_avg = take_local(K // SHARDS)
wrong_one = sorted(shards[0], key=key)[:K]

print("=== 跨分片聚合：局部 top-k 归并全局 top-k ===")
print("总记录 = %d, 分片数 = %d, k = %d" % (N, SHARDS, K))
print("全局 top-%d (id,score) =" % K)
for r in GLOBAL:
    print("  id=%-5d score=%d" % r)
print()
print("每分片记录数 = %s" % [len(shards[s]) for s in sorted(shards)])
print("每分片 top-3 score = %s"
      % [[r[1] for r in sorted(shards[s], key=key)[:3]] for s in sorted(shards)])
print()
print("[正确] 每分片各取 top-%d 再归并取 top-%d -> 与全局一致 : %s"
      % (K, K, correct == GLOBAL))
print("[错误] 把 k 平均摊到分片，每分片只取 top-%d 再归并 -> 一致 : %s"
      % (K // SHARDS, wrong_avg == GLOBAL))
print("[错误] 只在 shard0 内取 top-%d -> 一致 : %s" % (K, wrong_one == GLOBAL))
print()
print("归并正确性的充要条件：每分片返回的候选数 k_local >= 全局 k。")
print("判据 k_local=%d 时正确 : %s ; k_local=%d 时正确 : %s"
      % (K, correct == GLOBAL, K // SHARDS, wrong_avg == GLOBAL))
print("判据 正确结果的首位就是全局最高分 : %s" % (correct[0] == GLOBAL[0]))
